name: Kupsabiny
region: Sebei sub-region on the Ugandan slopes of Mount Elgon: Kapchorwa, Kween, Bukwo
translator_note: Everyday Kapchorwa Kupsabiny in a young professional's voice, drawing on Kalenjin cognates where a Sebei-specific form was not certain: 'Nam eng UG' (grab it on UG) for Book, 'Kuur simuit tai' for Call ahead, 'rabisyek ab simuit' for mobile money, 'ole ichame' for 'where you are comfortable'. The four slogan verbs are Lany. (board) Tuiyo. (gather) Kodi. Yokto. (send). Written with ŋ (ŋalek, aŋwan, neŋuŋ) and Kalenjin-style b/ch/ny spellings; Sebei orthography prefers p in some words where Nandi writes b, so a native reviewer should settle b/p and vowel length. The verb for 'to drive' is rendered with the noun dereba (I drive = 'Ane ko dereba'); verb inflections, passives and app-market words (rank, sandbox, plug-in, endpoint, wallet, forget) are listed under uncertain.
